metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: Personal agent skills: React standards, UI polish, and the review-to-PR shipping flow.
metadata.author: zainzafar90

skills.name: react-standards
skills.description: Enforces React naming, component and route structure, state ownership, readability, and test-first development.

skills.name: ocd
skills.description: A last-mile perfection pass on screens and code: UI polish, folder structure, naming, spacing, API and web consistency, security, speed and scale, share previews, and leftovers.

skills.name: lean
skills.description: Cuts the current change down to the least code that works, strips comments that narrate the code, and applies the fixes.

skills.name: commit
skills.description: Makes one-line commits on a human-named branch with no Co-Authored-By or AI attribution, and strips attribution from commits not yet pushed.

skills.name: ship
skills.description: Takes a finished branch through review, UI checks, cleanup, commits, and a PR description in one run.

skills.name: pr-review
skills.description: Reviews a pull request read-only and reports at most five confirmed findings with ready-to-apply suggestion blocks.

skills.name: pr-description
skills.description: Writes a short, scannable PR title and description from the current branch, with optional before and after screenshots and video.
